_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::heat#0 — the dynamics section name is 'SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC' in full, and every shortening is a hard abort at parse rather than a silent fall-back. Run on a self-contained 3-D HEX8 heat-conduction deck (TRANSP HEX8 + MAT_scatra, phi=1 on the x=0 face and 0 on the x=1 face, ten backward-Euler steps): the full spelling exits 0 with its result test CORRECT and prints 10 time steps (BASE_TIME_STEPS=10), while 'SCATRA DYNAMIC', 'SCALAR TRANSPORT' and 'TRANSPORT DYNAMIC' are each rejected by name from core/io/src/4C_io_input_file.cpp with "Section '<name>' is not a valid section name." and never reach a single time step (ABBREV_TIME_STEPS=0). The 'unknown section' parser banner an earlier version of this entry quoted appears nowhere (CLAIMED_UNKNOWN_SECTION_TEXT=0). Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
